svg.title: What to count before you order IBM i
svg.desc: Three things to count before the order: the IBM i P30 Enterprise and P20 Standard subscription editions; the IBM i Solution Edition, built on the Power S1112 for IBM i P05 clients; and the partitions, tier and edition, which we count with you before you order.
